title: MSFS 2024 Stream Deck XL
aircraft: Cessna 172 Skyhawk G1000 and FlyByWire A32NX (MSFS 2024)
notes: Stream Deck XL profiles for MSFS 2024. Profiles: MSFS2024 C172 G1000 (a main page with folder keys to its child pages; the repository README lists them), MSFS2024 A32NX (FlyByWire A32NX: main, FCU, OVHD and EFIS pages, the SYSTEMS page under OVHD, and the RADIO, XPDR and PED pages under EFIS) and MSFS2024 VisionJet (the MSFS 2024 default Cirrus Vision SF50: a main page with folder keys to its child pages). Scripts: XL24-SIMRATE.lua, XL24-COMPAD.lua, XL24-XPDRPAD.lua and XL24-A32NX.lua, installed into the plugin Scripts folder. Import each profile to your Stream Deck XL when the Profile Manager asks. For automatic switching, map MSFS2024 C172 G1000 in the Profile Mapping view with the search string asobo_c172sp_g1000. Most keys are not yet sim-tested: see CHANGELOG.md in the repository.
